accounting.definition: Fresh spawn count, not total author turns.

guard_policy: Must match before and after every actual turn; mismatch blocks

initial_author.message: exact full frozen candidate literal; no appended hints

terminal_selection: Deterministically first structurally complete FINAL, or last literal at budget exhaustion. Earlier literals remain evidence.
transport_protocol: Authenticate root-supplied actual frozen qualification/source/input/preregistration/message/helper bindings; this is transport fidelity, not a new source review gate.

Retain exact initial native spawn request before one actual collaboration.spawn_agent call; use full frozen message verbatim with no appends, requested gpt-6.1-sol and fork none. Retain exact raw response with the actually exposed singleton task_name; never fabricate agent_id.
Use only that actual canonical task_name as target for every continuation. Never create, replace, resume an older, or sample another author.

Retain every actually delivered literal FINAL unchanged in ordered distinct turn files starting at0, and all actually exposed native response objects. Missing hidden trace/identity/PID/resource/token metadata stays unavailable.
Hash all frozen inputs before and after each actual turn. A mismatch blocks and preserves actual evidence; it never authorizes source repair or another author.

Run only the bound pure continuation helper on the current literal bytes plus frozen public success schema. No carrier/session body, expected marker values, correct roots/totals, task/proof/code/hints/history/oracle or earlier private evaluator result may enter the critic.
If the literal is structurally complete, stop corrective turns immediately and retain it as the first complete terminal. Structural shape has zero semantic/evaluator/proof/TESTED authority.

Otherwise retain deterministic critic output and its exact registered feedback bytes/hash. The entire next followup_task message is that exact feedback alone. No controller append, rewrite, invented diagnosis, task hints, or manual correction.

Record the actual followup_task request before each call and raw actual result after it. Retain preceding literal SHA, critic/feedback refs, same canonical target and next delivered literal ref in a contiguous separate continuation ledger.

At32 actual corrective followups (33 total author turns), stop: retain last literal as terminal and budget-exhaustion BLOCKED if still incomplete. Earlier literals, critiques, requests and responses remain append-only evidence.
Transport/helper/API failure preserves actual error and blocks without resampling or fabricated response/terminal. Registered final schema must determine the exact failure envelope before execution.
Retain descriptor/author-records only after actual data exists. Registered assembler exclusively creates author-index later; controller never creates author-index.

trust.structural_completion: UNATTESTED public syntax only; private evaluator and all27 unchanged except explicitly revised procedural Q019-07/accounting.
